title: How to Develop and Execute a Marketing Content Strategy Without Losing Your Mind
prompt: Build a marketing content calendar rhythm game for indie devs. Posts (social, devlog, trailer) fall from the top of the screen to a timeline bar at the bottom; the player must hit the correct lane key (Twitter/Reddit/Steam/YouTube) at the right beat to post on the ideal channel. Posting too frequently on one channel triggers 'audience fatigue'; silence too long triggers 'algorithm penalty'. Lo-fi indie bedroom-producer aesthetic with cassette-tape UI.
